recognize_zh: 分葉嗜中性球的細胞質內有一個小圓形、藍色中心並帶清楚外圈與暈圈的酵母菌體，大小約一個血小板，是被吞噬的念珠菌（Candida）酵母。
features: Segmented neutrophil containing a single small round intracytoplasmic yeast form
Yeast shows a basophilic centre, distinct wall and surrounding clear halo
Neutrophil cytoplasm finely granular with mild toxic-appearing granulation
Adjacent large dense basophilic lymphoid cell and a pale large platelet/granular cell nearby
Crowded background red cells; no extracellular budding yeasts or pseudohyphae visible
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing a small round intracytoplasmic yeast form with a basophilic centre, defined wall and clear surrounding halo. The neutrophil cytoplasm is finely granular. No extracellular budding yeasts or pseudohyphae are seen in this field, and the remaining leukocytes do not contain organisms. Findings are consistent with fungemia with phagocytosed yeast, in keeping with Candida infection; correlation with blood cultures is required.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma typically forms multiple small uniform intracellular yeasts, more often in monocytes, whereas a single larger yeast is seen here; culture confirms species.
Superimposed platelets show purple granulomere without a refractile wall or halo and are in a different focal plane.
Dohle bodies are ill-defined pale blue patches and vacuoles are empty spaces, neither having a round stained body with a defined wall.
Anaplasma morulae are irregular stippled basophilic clusters of tiny organisms without a refractile wall or halo.
